notes: This baseline protects the v0.3.2 Stage01 and Stage02 business implementations while permitting intentional Stage03 integration changes to the workspace, dispatcher, MCP router and installer.
One canonical Revit product line with manual and MCP entry points.
Stage01 permits initialization of RVTs that already contain model elements.
Stage01 optional fields use one collapsed section per directory.
Stage01 and Stage02 detailed status regions have fixed heights.
Project conditions are the first required declaration step.
Users must select actual conditions or explicitly confirm that none apply.
Stage02 refuses legacy all-false condition payloads until the declaration is completed.
